reviewers.agent: general-purpose subagent (Opus 4.8) — verified every capability, metric label set, registry field, and money kind against the code; quickstart commands run end-to-end by the author

records.finding: money.md described the baseline as the median of the last N NON-HOLIDAY weeks, implying holiday exclusion — but v0 never applies the holiday calendar (Compute passes no Holiday func), contradicting registry.md.
records.evidence: engine/unrealized.go builds baseline.Config with only LookbackWeeks; it notes the calendar is 'not yet applied'.
records.reason: Reworded to 'last N weeks; the registry can name a holiday calendar to exclude, though v0 does not yet apply one' — matching registry.md and the code.

records.finding: semconv.md listed the outcome label as success|failed|deferred (3), but the result enumeration has five (adds abandoned, unknown) and the emitter stamps any valid result.
records.evidence: biz/context.go Result constants + Valid() accept success/failed/deferred/abandoned/unknown; emit stamps outcome=string(result).
records.reason: Now lists all five as the bounded result enumeration, without over-claiming which legs consume which.

records.finding: The reconcile example's 'sql:, stripe:, ...' implied more schemes; only sql: and stripe: are accepted.
records.evidence: registry validation rejects any scheme other than sql/stripe.
records.reason: Changed to 'known schemes: sql:, stripe:' (no open-ended ...).
